Behavior is pre-existing and kept; the text was wrong and is fixed in 6bd5d76e.

The TaskBatch.valuesOrThrow part concerns the package-private TaskBatch, not the public result, and was not changed.
Confirmed: the scope close() is package-private and ParRuntime.close() does not cancel admitted work; public docs listed close(). Removed in 6bd5d76e.
Confirmed: task-group-cancellation.md kept the single-CAS, cancellation-first derivation text. Rewritten in 6bd5d76e.
Confirmed: lifecycle rules and the adopt Javadoc stated the cascade without the policy qualification. Fixed in 6bd5d76e.
Confirmed: real 200 ms deadlines could fire before the failure settled on a loaded runner, and awaitCallerParked returned silently. Moved to ManualClock and a failing wait in 6bd5d76e.
